summary: Workspace capability is revalidated across browsing contexts without losing the conversation draft; only server responses grant command access.
invariants: Focus, pageshow and visible-page return revalidate server capability.
Cross-tab capability messages invalidate local state but never directly grant command access.
Superseded or unmounted requests cannot commit capability; auth expiry and logout abort pending requests and clear authority.
Command revocation and recovery preserve the mounted conversation draft.
forbidden: Granting command access directly from a broadcast snapshot.
